messages: Tutorial started: Explore merchants, trade wares, and open doors!
(Lys): "Off to the inn - Hilde will want the pots on."
(Reeve Osric Pike): "The tithe won't count itself."
Old Bertram is crying the morning news by the well.
Lys is helping in the inn kitchen.
Barnaby opened the shop for business.
Dorran is hauling crates for Barnaby.
Fenwick has his usual seat at the Drowsy Dragon.
Lady Ashgrove is sneering at Barnaby's wares.
Greaves is buying for the Vane household, very particularly.
